title: Medical Device Software Lifecycle Qualification Evidence Kit
software_safety_class: Class C (Highest Risk: Patient Implants & Surgical Guides)

safety_architecture.fail_closed_guarantee: Invalid or out-of-bounds parameters reject at resolve time with nonzero exit code.
safety_architecture.zero_division_immunity: All trigonometric and division operations verified against singularities in Lean 4 (Dry.Geometry.Kinematics).
safety_architecture.deterministic_execution: Strict IEEE-754 arithmetic with ban on ambient system clock, RNG, and undefined pointers.
safety_architecture.formal_verification: Lean 4 machine-checked proofs with 0 axioms and 0 sorry across 3,140 targets.

hazard_mitigation_matrix.hazard_description: Excessive volumetric flow rate causing structural porosity or delamination in titanium bone implant.
hazard_mitigation_matrix.verification_method: Automated IR analysis comparing Q(s) <= Q_max

hazard_mitigation_matrix.hazard_description: Sudden tool plunge or axis singularity gouging patient-specific surgical cutting guide.
hazard_mitigation_matrix.verification_method: Machine-checked theorem with 0 axioms and 0 sorry

hazard_mitigation_matrix.hazard_description: Discontinuous toolpath trajectory causing high-acceleration jerk and machine vibration.
Pore size or wall thickness divergence in titanium osseointegration TPMS lattice structures.
hazard_mitigation_matrix.mitigation_contract: Rule bead & bead-volume with deterministic marching squares resolution (crates/core/src/generate/tpms.rs)
hazard_mitigation_matrix.verification_method: Exact boundary clamping and volume conservation checks

hazard_mitigation_matrix.hazard_description: Multi-axis toolholder or dual-robot arm collision damaging orthopedic implant stock or fixture.
hazard_mitigation_matrix.mitigation_contract: Collision checkers in crates/core/src/verify/collision.rs and crates/core/src/multi_robot.rs
hazard_mitigation_matrix.verification_method: Continuous swept-sphere minimum clearance bounding check

lifecycle_activities.software_unit_testing: 500+ unit tests across Rust core and SDKs
